name: Miami Lakes
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Miami Lakes, FL 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Miami Lakes, FL: Frozen JR. at Main Street Players, plus the Main Street Festival of Lights tradition.
lede: Miami Lakes starts the season with the Main Street Festival of Lights in November, and in December families can catch Frozen JR. at Main Street Players.
celebrates: Miami Lakes kicks off Christmas on Main Street. The 2026 Festival of Lights, on Saturday, November 21, brought a farmers market from 10 am, live performances from 4 pm, holiday photo ops, a toy drive and the tree lighting at 6:30 pm. In December the Main Street Players theater, at 6812 Main Street, stages Frozen JR. from December 4 to 6, and the Town of Miami Lakes calendar lists more events at Veterans Park.
lastyear: In 2025 the Main Street Festival of Lights was the 40th annual, held on Saturday, November 22, presented by The Graham Companies and the Main Street Merchants. The Town of Miami Lakes also held a Holiday Festival at Veterans Park, 15151 NW 82nd Avenue, on December 12, 2025, at 6:30 pm, with a Santa photo op, food trucks, holiday arts and crafts, lighted displays and holiday movies.
facts: Miami Lakes' Festival of Lights is a long running tradition: the 2026 festival was the 41st annual, after the 40th in 2025, and the Miami Laker reported that The Graham Companies and the Main Street Merchants had presented it for 39 years by the 40th. Main Street Players, the community theater, sits on the same Main Street and performed at the 2026 festival.
trains: Tri-Rail serves South Florida with stations that include Opa-locka and Hialeah Market, and Metrorail's Green Line ends at Palmetto station, 7701 NW 79th Avenue. Brightline leaves from MiamiCentral in downtown Miami. For a train day, the Gold Coast Railroad Museum in Miami has the presidential car Ferdinand Magellan and a narrow gauge train ride.
train_links: More than 40 historic rail cars, the presidential car Ferdinand Magellan and a narrow gauge train ride in Miami.
traditions: A November festival with a farmers market, live performances, photo ops, a toy drive and a tree lighting at 6:30 pm.
Town of Miami Lakes Holiday Festival
The Town's Youth Activities Task Force held a holiday fair at Veterans Park in December 2025 with Santa photos, crafts and movies.
The community theater on Main Street stages a winter musical each December.
The Festival of Lights asks families to bring a new, unwrapped toy.
kidfact: Miami Lakes holds its Festival of Lights on Main Street. In 2026 it was the 41st time the town lit its tree.
faq: Is the Miami Lakes Festival of Lights still on?
No. The 2026 Festival of Lights was Saturday, November 21, with the tree lighting at 6:30 pm.
Is there a December holiday event in Miami Lakes?
Main Street Players stages Frozen JR. at 6812 Main Street from December 4 to 6. The Town's calendar lists a Reindeer Run 5k at Veterans Park on December 12.
